After falling to a new record low last week, President Donald Trump's approval rating rose by 3 percentage points in the latest Economist/YouGov poll, with more than 1 in 3 Americans giving him a positive review.

The poll, released Tuesday, Nov. 17, found that 35% of respondents approve of Trump's time in the White House, up 3 percentage points from last week's Economist/YouGov poll.

In last week's poll, Trump hit his lowest approval rating (32%) during his second term in the White House.
